prompt:
Paint ONE building for a top-down pixel-art JRPG town map, in the classic 3/4 top-down RPG view: the roof is seen from above (it fills the upper coloured block of the guide) and the front wall is seen straight on (the lower block). The attached image is an exact layout guide drawn at the final proportions: keep the outer silhouette, the roof/wall split line, the door (dark brown rectangle: it must stay exactly there, same size, at ground level, a real door you can walk through) and the windows (yellow rectangles) in exactly the same places. You may add small details (eaves, trim, drainpipe, flower boxes, crates by the wall, a chimney poking above the roof into the empty top margin).
This building: a one-storey house in a small old hill village of farmers and storytellers. dark brown wooden shingle roof walls of stacked round logs with notched corners. Windows have small panes glowing warm amber from inside (the only light). Flower boxes under some windows. The whole image is 176 x 224 art pixels (each art pixel 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent (the magenta in the guide is background). No ground, no shadow, no people, no text, no letters.
revised_prompt: Edit the attached layout-guide image into ONE standalone one-storey log house sprite for a top-down pixel-art JRPG town map. CRITICAL: use the provided image as an exact registration template at its original full extent, including the bottom part: preserve the exterior silhouette, the exact horizontal roof/front-wall dividing line, and all guide window and door rectangles in precisely their original locations and sizes. The dark brown door at ground level in the original guide MUST remain a functional full-size walk-through door in exactly its guide position, not relocated, diminished, or obscured. The yellow window rectangles likewise remain exactly placed and sized, but add amber-lit little panes and frames. Roof is the upper big flat rectangular guide block, viewed from above, NOT a triangular gable or isometric sloping silhouette; wall is the lower rectangular guide block seen straight on. Transform roof into dark brown overlapping wooden shingles, subtly irregular crisp block clusters; wall into clearly defined stacked horizontal round timber logs with notched corners. Add restrained eave trim, flower boxes directly beneath some of the existing windows, and maybe a tiny chimney above roof within empty top margin. No additional windows or doors. Small old hill village farmers' and storytellers' lived-in home. Clean soft neutral overcast upper-left illumination, with glowing amber window panes as only emitted light; no external light pools, cast shadows, darkness, ground, people, text. Fully transparent background everywhere that was magenta in guide; no magenta remaining. Premium modern HD JRPG pixel art with strictly uniform crisp square art pixels on the original 7x7 pixel grid, deliberately placed chunky clusters of 3–10 art pixels, no antialiasing, blur, noise, photographic texture, or checkerboard dithering. Earthy rich hue shifted 4–6 shades per material: purplish reddish saturated shadows, warm yellow highlights. Preserve source full-image aspect ratio and dimensions (176 x 224 art pixels / 1232 x 1568 image pixels).
